data.long_meaning: From the Irish name Domhnaill, derived from the Old Irish word domhan, meaning 'world' or 'land'. The name Donall means 'bright ruler' or 'ruler of the world'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Donall usually hope their child will grow to embody bright ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Ντόναλ
